decisions.title: Read your observed dexterous prayer scroll
decisions.why: The scroll can unlock Rigour, a permanent ranged prayer upgrade relevant to CoX, including accounts already using Bowfa or a twisted bow. Keeping the scroll in storage provides no permanent unlock.
decisions.alternative: Keep using your currently available lower-level prayers and save the scroll if you deliberately want a spare. Another gear grind is not required to read this owned scroll.
decisions.tradeoff: Reading consumes this scroll. The unlock remains after consumption; it does not prove that your levels already allow using the prayer.
decisions.effort: Small one-off action once the observed scroll is retrieved and unnoted. No drop grind or time estimate.
decisions.access: An observed scroll and confirmed locked prayer; no skill requirement to read. Retrieve from bank first if needed.
decisions.completion: Rigour unlock varbit is true; scroll absence is never completion evidence.
decisions.applicability: A positive inventory/equipment/session-bank observation of the exact scroll and a known false unlock.
notes: Reading has no skill requirement; using the prayer needs its documented Prayer and Defence levels. Scroll possession and permanent unlocks are different facts.
decisions.preparation: A positive inventory/equipment/session-bank observation of the exact scroll and a known false unlock.
decisions.benefitReason: Confirmed locked permanent prayer with an observed scroll.

decisions.title: Plan ordinary team CoX with your observed weapons
decisions.why: You have recognised weapons across three styles and meet this catalogue's stated planning baseline. Agreeing a team setup with these options can be more useful than postponing practice for another weapon grind. This remains a repeatable prompt; raid history and player skill are unknown.
decisions.alternative: Use your observed rune crossbow if you decline CG; Bowfa with active crystal armour and a twisted bow are other recognised options. Dragon hunter crossbows, eclipse atlatl setups and dragon hunter wand spell setups appear in current CoX guidance but are outside this baseline. Review those with your team or a specialist planner; no mandatory Bowfa route is implied.
decisions.tradeoff: A learner team must agree your setup and supply roles. This catalogue does not establish raid access, armour completeness, weapon access unlocks, charges, ammunition, supplies or player skill. It does not certify solo or Challenge Mode readiness.
decisions.effort: Team coordination and practice; repeatable planning opportunity, not an inferred unfinished account unlock. Learning time varies.
decisions.access: Planning has no game requirement. CoX entry separately needs access to Great Kourend, which is unobserved. Equipping a lance additionally needs the Firemaking (not pyre), Fishing and Smithing sections of Barbarian Training; these unlocks are unobserved. Crystal equipment has quest requirements; this catalogue does not verify them.
decisions.completion: Repeatable planning prompt; no raid history is observed and no first-kill claim is made.
decisions.applicability: 80+ Attack/Strength/Ranged/Magic/Hitpoints and 70+ Defence/Prayer (authored preparation baseline, not game access); recognised positive weapons and their wield levels. Bowfa selection additionally needs observed active crystal pieces and 70 Agility.
notes: The checked skill and three-style baseline is authored preparation, not game access. Team roles, full raid switches, supplies and actual access remain unverified.
decisions.preparation: 80+ Attack/Strength/Ranged/Magic/Hitpoints and 70+ Defence/Prayer (authored preparation baseline, not game access); recognised positive weapons and their wield levels. Bowfa selection additionally needs observed active crystal pieces and 70 Agility.
decisions.benefitReason: Recognised three-style kit supports ordinary team preparation.

decisions.title: Assemble a swamp trident from your observed magic fang
decisions.why: You have a magic fang and a seas trident. A swamp trident gives your CoX magic kit a stronger built-in spell without starting another weapon drop grind. This can still help a Bowfa account whose magic weapon remains a seas trident.
decisions.alternative: Keep using the seas trident if scale upkeep is unwelcome. An owned swamp trident, Sanguinesti staff, Eye of Ayak, Shadow or dragon hunter wand suppresses this assembly prompt; compare that option first. The wand needs a suitable spellbook, spells and runes, so possession alone does not establish a usable spell setup.
decisions.tradeoff: Uncharge the seas trident before assembly, retrieve and unnote components, then arrange runes and Zulrah scales. Using scales adds upkeep. A fang used here is unavailable for a toxic staff of the dead unless the trident is dismantled. No charges or supply quantities are inferred.
